QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Harsh Reality
QuestInfo.0: The same guy from Base Camp that nearly wandered off the cliff somehow made it safely down the steep path to town. But he still looks like he's in pretty bad shape. Ullan says Aruhi wasn't always like that. He's got something horribly tragic in his past.
